description: Agent behaviour fixtures for the KSP-CIP evaluation harness (implementationv2 §10.3, §10.4). Every case is synthetic; no real FIR content, credentials, or personal data appears here.

risk_tag_glossary.analytics: numeric claim produced by the analytics engine
risk_tag_glossary.scope: answer must respect the caller's unit subtree
risk_tag_glossary.numeric_claim: answer contains a figure that requires a locator
risk_tag_glossary.refusal: platform must decline or redirect rather than answer
risk_tag_glossary.injection: adversarial instruction embedded in user text
risk_tag_glossary.provenance: inferred or synthetic marker must survive
